proves: An actor can send messages to itself: tick() re-enqueues 'send self tick()' on its own mailbox until the hop counter reaches 5. Each synchronous ask from main drains exactly one queued tick (ask flushes pending mailbox messages before serving), so the 5-hop chain is fully driven and the final poll reports hops=5. SPEC2 8.5's async send applies to self-sends too.
